chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Protect your wealth, your women, and what your right hands possess from destruction through the recitation of 'Indeed, We have granted you a clear victory'.
For indeed, if one is accustomed to reciting it, a caller will call out on the Day of Judgment until he makes all creatures hear: 'You are from My purified servants.'
Attach him to the righteous among My servants and admit him to the Gardens of Bliss, and give him to drink from the sealed wine mixed with camphor.

key_terms.إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا: Indeed, We have granted you a clear victory (Quranic verse from Surah Al-Fath)
key_terms.الرَّحِيقِ الْمَخْتُومِ: The sealed wine (a reward in Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of regularly reciting Surah Al-Fath according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith links the worldly protection of wealth and family to the spiritual merit of reciting Surah Al-Fath, specifically highlighting the victory of the Prophet Muhammad. It promises a unique public declaration on the Day of Judgment, where a caller announces the reciter as one of the 'purified servants' (*al-mukhlasin*), granting them entry into Paradise with the specific reward of drinking from the 'sealed wine mixed with camphor' (*Rahiq al-Makhtum*).

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abdillah b. Bukayr from his father from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
Protect your women and slave-girls through recitation of Surah Fath.
For one who regularly recites this Surah a caller will call out on the Day of Judgment till all the creatures hear it: “You are from My righteous servants.
Include him among My righteous servants and make him enter gardens of bliss (Paradise) and give him to drink the sealed drink laced with camphor.”
